keywords: drywall anchors, self drilling drywall anchor, plasterboard anchor, gypsum anchor, drywall fixings, drywall anchor load limit

heading.en: Why a Plastic Plug Fails in Plasterboard
heading.zh: 普通墙塞为什么在石膏板上不管用

body.en: A conventional wall plug needs material around the hole for its fins to press against. Plasterboard is a thin paper-faced gypsum sheet, usually 9.5 or 12.5 mm, with nothing behind it but air. A plug driven into that hole grips only the paper and the gypsum skin, and the whole fixing pulls out as a small disc of board. A drywall anchor is designed for exactly this: it is a self-drilling fastener that cuts its own small hole, then expands or screws into the cavity and creates a bearing area larger than the hole. The result is a fixing that holds a shelf, a mirror, a television bracket or a run of trunking without a stud behind it. The trade-off is load: these are light-duty fixings, and understanding where the limit sits is the whole art of specifying them.
body.zh: 普通墙塞需要孔周围有材料让翼片去压。石膏板是一层薄薄的纸面石膏，常见 9.5 或 12.5 mm，后面基本是空的。塞子打进这种孔只咬住纸面和石膏皮层，连着一小片板整块被拉出来。干墙锚就是为这个场景设计的：它自钻出小孔，然后括胀或旋入空腔，形成一个比孔径大得多的承压面。结果是不靠龙骨也能固定搁板、镜子、电视支架或整条线槽。代价是荷载：这类属于轻载固定，搞清楚上限在哪，才是选型的全部功夫。

body.en: Manufacturer figures are usually quoted as a shear load per anchor in new board of a stated thickness, and they assume perfect installation. In practice a self-drilling anchor in 12.5 mm plasterboard holds roughly 10 to 20 kg in shear; in 9.5 mm board the same anchor holds noticeably less, often half as much, because the bearing area is smaller and the board tears earlier. Pull-out resistance is lower than shear, which is why a shelf loaded downwards is fine while a heavy item hanging on a bracket high on a wall is not. Then add the realities of site: board fixed on 600 mm stud centres with a single screw pattern, board that has been skimmed with plaster, and board that has been damp. For anything above a shelf or a mirror, use two anchors rather than one, and for televisions, wall cabinets, grab rails or air-conditioning, fix into a stud or into a solid backing.
body.zh: 厂家数据通常给出规定板厚、全新板材下的单锚剪切荷载，而且假定安装完美。实际在 12.5 mm 石膏板里，自钻锚的剪切承载大约 10 到 20 kg；同样锚在 9.5 mm 板上明显更低，常常只有一半，因为承压面更小、板更早撕裂。抗拔能力比抗剪更低，所以搁板向下压没问题，而挂在墙面高处支架上的重物就不行。再把现场因素加上：龙骨间距 600 mm、只打一颗钉的板、表面做过抹灰的板、以及受潮的板。超过搁板和镜子的荷载，用一个以上锚；电视、吊柜、扶手、空调，必须打到龙骨或实心衬板。

heading.en: The Three Types You Will Be Quoted

body.en: Self-drilling anchors are the most common export item: a zinc-plated screw inside a nylon or zinc body, 3.5 to 4.8 mm screw diameter, 25 to 40 mm overall length, driven straight into the board with a screwdriver or a drill on low torque. The screw can be removed and refitted several times, which makes them popular for fixtures that get adjusted. Expansion types, often called plugs for plasterboard, are pushed into the hole and expand as the screw is driven; they are cheaper and simpler but hold less in thin board and are easier to over-drive. Toggle types use a metal bar that flips sideways behind the board and are the strongest of the three in a cavity, but need a bigger hole, cost more and cannot be used where the cavity is filled. For distributor stock, the self-drilling type sells best because one size covers most domestic work.
body.zh: 自钻型是最常见的出口品：镀锌螺钉装在同为尼龙的或锌合金的本体里，螺钉直径 3.5 到 4.8 mm，总长 25 到 40 mm，用螺丝刀或低扭矩电钻直接钻进板里。螺钉可以拆下再装回多次，适合需要反复调整的固定。扩胀型常被称作石膏板塞，塞进孔里靠螺钉撑开；更便宜也简单，但在薄板上承载更低，也更容易拧过头。翻转型（俗称蝴蝶锚）用金属横杆在板后翻转，空腔里承载最高，但孔更大、更贵，空腔被填充的位置不能用。做分销备货，自钻型最好卖，因为一个规格覆盖多数家装活。

heading.en: Fitting Steps That Decide the Result

body.en: Four steps make or break the fixing. First, mark the hole and drive the anchor with the drill on low torque or by hand; high torque tears the board before the anchor has expanded. Second, drive until the anchor sits flush, not proud and not recessed, because a proud anchor levers the board when loaded. Third, stop if you hit a stud: a screw into the stud is always stronger than any anchor in board, so relocate the fixing. Fourth, never over-tighten the final screw; the screw should clamp the fixture, not crush the anchor body. Two site habits also help: vacuum the drill dust out of the hole in hospitals and clean rooms, and keep a spare anchor of each size on the van, because a job stopped for one missing fixing costs more than the whole box.
body.zh: 四个步骤决定成败。第一，标记孔位后用低扭矩电钻或手工把锚拧入；扭矩过大会在锚还没张开时就把板撕坏。第二，拧到与板面齐平，既不能凸出也不能凹陷，凸出的锚受力时会撬板。第三，打到龙骨就停：螺钉打进龙骨永远比任何板内锚强，应当改位置。第四，最后一颗螺钉不要过度拧紧，它的作用是压住固定物，不是把锚体压碎。两个现场习惯也有用：医院和洁净室要用吸尘器把钻孔粉尘吸走；车上各尺寸备一个，因为缺一个件停工的代价比一整盒还高。

body.en: Drywall anchors are sold in small boxes and the packaging is half the product. The common retail pack is 50, 100 or 200 pieces with the screws included, in a printed box with a barcode and a size chart; the export bulk pack is a plain poly bag inside a carton of 20 to 25 kg. Decide the pack before the order, because printed boxes carry a minimum order quantity and a lead time that bulk bags do not. Most containers mix three or four sizes: a large size for heavy domestic fixing, a medium that covers most work, and a small size for light items. Keep the sizes clearly marked on the bag, since the difference between a 3.5 mm and a 4.8 mm anchor is not visible once the boxes are open on a shelf, and mixing them in one bin causes wrong fitments and callbacks.
body.zh: 干墙锚以小盒销售，包装本身就是产品的一半。常见零售装是 50、100 或 200 颗含螺钉，彩盒印刷带条码和规格表；出口散装是塑料袋装，外套 20 到 25 kg 纸箱。要在下单前定包装，因为彩盒有起订量和交期，散装没有。多数柜子混三到四个规格：大规格用于重载家装，中规格覆盖大部分活，小规格用于轻物。袋上必须标清规格，因为 3.5 mm 与 4.8 mm 的锚拆箱摆上货架后看不出差别，混在一个货位里就会装错、产生返工。

heading.en: What to Send Before We Quote

body.en: Send the board thickness, the typical load, the type preferred (self-drilling, expansion or toggle), the pack format (retail box or bulk bag), the screw finish and the quantity by size. If the buyer has no specification, describe the application: shelves and mirrors, television brackets, trunking, bathroom fittings or ceiling grid. That is enough to recommend a size and a pack. Ask for a sample box by air for a new retail line, and a carton sample for a distributor. TradeGo supplies self-drilling drywall anchors with zinc-plated screws from 3.5 to 4.8 mm, 25 to 40 mm length, white and blue bodies, in 50 to 500 piece boxes, mixed sizes per carton, with printed retail boxes on request.
body.zh: 提供板厚、典型荷载、偏好的类型（自钻、扩胀或翻转）、包装形式（彩盒或散装袋）、螺钉镀层和各规格数量。买家没有规范时，描述用途就够了：搁板与镜子、电视支架、线槽、洁具或吊顶龙骨。有这些就能推荐规格和包装。新开零售线先空运一盒样品，分销客户要一箱样品。TradeGo 供应自钻干墙锚，配镀锌螺钉，直径 3.5 到 4.8 mm、长度 25 到 40 mm，白蓝两色本体，50 到 500 颗盒装，可混规格装箱，彩盒可按要求印刷。
